publish.caption:
Already evaluating workflow automation? The next decision is not which AI tool to buy. It is which workflow is worth automating first.

The $499 AI Workflow Opportunity Audit maps one real workflow, exposes leaks, ranks 5–10 automation candidates by impact, effort, reversibility and risk, and returns ROI scenarios plus a 30-day action plan.

Built for founders and operations leaders who want the decision before the implementation.
